articleTitle: Noise reducing effect of negative feedback optical amplifier using an optical triode
publicationTitle: Technical Digest of the Eighteenth Microoptics Conference
abstract: We demonstrated that noise reducing effect in negative feedback optical amplifier was realized using an optical triode. The relationship between inverted signal intensity with bit error rate was measured. Output signal with low baseline, suppressed overshoot part was observed and power penalty was improved by 15 dB.

articleTitle: Wide luminance angular distribution and low color shift liquid crystal displays with surface diffusing system
publicationTitle: Technical Digest of the Eighteenth Microoptics Conference
abstract: We demonstrated the wide luminance angular distribution liquid crystal display (LCD) with the surface diffusing system (SDS), on the basis of the novel multiple light scattering simulation for the single scattering layer film. Moreover, the color shift of the SDS-LCD was lower than that of a commercial LCD.

articleTitle: Fabrication of long-period fiber-gratings by low-pressure mercury lamp-effect of grating length
publicationTitle: Technical Digest of the Eighteenth Microoptics Conference
abstract: Long-period fiber gratings were fabricated by exposure with a low-pressure mercury lamp. The effects on the grating length were studied. The exposure time was reduced to 2/3 for a grating length of 30 mm compared with that of 20 mm. The temperature sensitivity was measured, and the sensing applications were discussed.

articleTitle: All-optical gain control scheme for a remotely pumped multicore erbium-doped fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: Technical Digest of the Eighteenth Microoptics Conference
abstract: A novel all-optical automatic gain control scheme for a remotely-pumped multicore EDFA having a fiber ring laser configuration is proposed. We measured the difference of the gain spectra among the pump light wavelengths/powers and revealed that the difference was caused by the spectral hole burning effect.

articleTitle: Fabrication of a sealed wire grid polarizer by use of room-temperature-bonding
publicationTitle: Technical Digest of the Eighteenth Microoptics Conference
abstract: A wire grid polarizer with the high durability of thermal oxidation for UV spectral range is proposed. The wire grids were fabricated by KrF lithography and dry etching. The substrate on which wire grids are mounted and a substrate cover were bonded in high vacuum by room-temperature-bonding technique. This sealed wire grid polarizer shows very good thermal stability in the extinction ratio in UV spectral range.

articleTitle: 10-Gbit/s QPSK × single-channel fourier-encoded synchronous OCDM transmission over 50-km SMF
publicationTitle: Technical Digest of the Eighteenth Microoptics Conference
abstract: 10-Gbit/s quadrature phase shift keying × single-channel Fourier-encoded synchronous optical coded division multiplexing (FE-SOCDM) signals are experimentally transmitted over a 50-km single mode fiber. The experiment results show a transmission of the FE-SOCDM signals is successfully accomplished with less than 25-% error vector magnitude.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of semi-transparent screen using micro patterns and metal coating for head-up display
publicationTitle: Technical Digest of the Eighteenth Microoptics Conference
abstract: Semi-transparent screen with micro patterns and metal coating was designed by optical simulation and fabrication for direct type head-up display (HUD). Micro patterns were optimized to enhance the uniformity and reduce the glare with a range of parameters such as aspect ratio, radius and fill factor. Metal coating is also used to control the transmittance of the screen. Finally, the illuminance uniformity more than 70% was realized in the eye-box with a range of reflectivity for the HUD application.

articleTitle: Development of laser backlight LCD TV
publicationTitle: Technical Digest of the Eighteenth Microoptics Conference
abstract: We have developed a new backlight system that uses a laser diode for one of the light sources. This backlight system uses two kinds of light souce. One is a red laser diode and the other is a cyan LED. a laser and LEDs as the light source. The liquid crystal television display equipped with this particular backlight system has vivid colors that can be recognized at first glance.
